title: Managing Screen Time: A Family Contract
summary: At ages 7-9, the child seeks digital independence. The solution: create a 'screen-time contract' together—set times, screen-free zones (bedroom, dining table), and real alternatives.
try_this: This week: Sit together and write the screen-time contract (two hours daily, no screens one hour before bed). Sign it together and hang it up.
reflection_prompts: How many days did your child adhere to the contract?
Which alternative did they enjoy the most?
